sector_model: Single product commercial biopharma (mid): product concentration (ARCALYST), profit share with licensor, patent and exclusivity runway, pipeline spend; FCF after collaboration expenses; no debt.
thesis: Kiniksa (Nasdaq: KNSA; Bermuda-origin plc, US GAAP filer), Q3 2026 10-Q filed 2026-10-27 (statements, collaboration notes, share cover read; MD&A narrative not read). Q3 revenue 285.97M vs 180.86M (+58.1%), 9M 743.84M vs 475.44M (+56.5%), all ARCALYST net product revenue in the US. Q3 operating income 54.2M vs 24.0M; 9M NI 95.4M vs 44.8M after 27.5M tax provision (effective rate about 22%, so earnings are not tax distorted). Collaboration expenses (Regeneron profit share) 105.8M in Q3 = 37% of revenue. TTM (FY25 + 9M26 - 9M25): revenue 946.0M, NI 109.6M, OCF 198.8M, capex 1.6M, FCF 197.2M (yield below); SBC 45.0M. Shares 78,571,705 (cover 2026-10-23) x 94.23 close (2026-11-16) = market cap 7,404M = 68x TTM NI; FCF yield 2.66% (2.06% after SBC). Cash and short-term Treasuries 568.8M, no debt in the balance sheet; EV about 6,835M = 7.2x TTM revenue. Total liabilities 273.1M vs assets 983.2M. Price implies sustained rapid ARCALYST growth into recurrent pericarditis plus KPL-387 success; evidence supporting is profit growth of about 2x year on year.
counterthesis: One drug supplies all revenue, and 37% of it goes to Regeneron as collaboration expense, so margins are structurally capped. At about 68x TTM earnings and a 2.6% FCF yield the market already pays for the growth. Inventory doubled to 108.0M (from 54.9M) and receivables doubled to 30.8M in nine months, so operating cash flow (145M for 9M versus NI 95M) must be read against working capital timing; cash plus investments rose from 414.1M to 568.8M in nine months (cash alone fell as money moved into Treasuries). Deferred tax asset 198.0M supports a tax rate that may change. KPL-387 Phase 3 data not until 2H27 and commercial launch 2028 to 2029 per 10-Q, so near term growth relies on ARCALYST alone. Share count rises with SBC (78.6M vs 73.6M weighted basic last year); diluted weighted 84.9M implies about 8% more shares than basic, so per share value is closer to a 84.9M count (market cap about 8.0B on diluted).
invalidation: Thesis fails if ARCALYST quarterly revenue growth decelerates below about 25% year on year, gross-to-net erodes, a biosimilar or competing pericarditis therapy takes share, or KPL-387 Phase 3 fails.
